title: Unique tangent flows at the first surface singularity

result.label: Unique tangent flows at the first surface singularity
result.statement: Proves the first-singular-time case of tangent-flow uniqueness for smooth compact connected embedded surfaces without boundary in ℝ 3 . At every singular point, all fixed-center backward tangent flows agree as area measures at every negative time in the original ambient coordinates, without mean-convexity or a prescribed tangent model.
